blocks.text: A reset action should set the values that belong to its feature. Keep its scope clear so it does not erase unrelated browser choices.
Use a React project with Zustand 5 installed. Hook examples belong in React components; vanilla examples use zustand/vanilla. These package imports require your own build tool.

blocks.text: The reading values return to their starting values and the reset action remains available.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not clear all localStorage to reset one feature. Remove only the keys that feature owns if storage is used.
